description: Enroute chart ICAO - Upper Airspace; Rutna karta ICAO - Gornji zračni prostor is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by crocontrol.hr. ICAO route map - Upper airspace at a scale of 1:1 350 000. The map covers the entire territory of the Republic of Croatia (FIR Zagreb) and shows the upper ATS routes including distances, significant points, radio navigational aids with WGS-84 coordinates, frequency and identification, hazardous areas, conditionally prohibited areas and prohibited areas. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Enroute chart ICAO - Upper Airspace; ICAO Route Map - Upper Airspace" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspiregeoportal, ICAO, zračni promet, gornji zračni prostor, prometne mreže. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
